design.style: Clean modern productivity UI with crisp white cards, vibrant accent badges, and generous touch targets
design.typography: Modern sans-serif with bold hierarchy and clean readability

screens.name: My Tasks
screens.purpose: Create, read, edit, toggle, and delete all tasks seamlessly within a single interactive scrollable dashboard.
keyElements: Header with live date, greeting, and completed vs total progress bar
Scrollable task list container with task cards (completion checkboxes, inline editable text, priority badges (Low, Med, High), and delete buttons)
Persistent bottom quick-add bar with priority selector and instant add action
Search and clear-all completed tasks quick action in header menu
Empty state with playful placeholder when list is clear

plan.summary: A clean, ultra-focused single-screen todo manager with seamless inline CRUD operations in a scrollable list view.
plan.navigation: Single self-contained, scrollable screen handling all interactions inline.
plan.targetUsers: Anyone who wants a zero-friction, single-screen task list to capture, edit, and check off daily todos, even when the list is long.
coreFeatures: One-tap inline task creation from bottom bar
Instant completion toggling with progress counter
Inline tap-to-edit for task titles and priorities
Quick-swipe or button tap to delete tasks
Filter views for All, Active, and Completed, with scrollable view of tasks
